notes: This is an explicitly mixed-precision INT8 candidate: eligible Conv, MatMul, and Gemm nodes outside /decoder/generator/ receive S8S8 weight QDQ; every eligible node inside that prefix retains its original FP32 weight input after the all-eligible-op candidate showed a consistent spectral shift in the supporting screen.

Excluded generator nodes can consume activations dequantized after upstream quantized nodes; exclusion preserves their operators and weights, not an entirely quantization-isolated subgraph. ConvTranspose and LSTM also remain FP32 because they are outside this conservative QDQ recipe.
Calibration token IDs are produced with pinned eSpeak NG and the exact archive data. Quality-gate synthesis itself always uses sherpa-onnx's frontend.

The candidate must load and synthesize through sherpa-onnx CPU before it is eligible for listening. The ONNX Runtime quantizer's retained outer-graph ordering diagnostic is documented separately; the exact source passes the checker. Android deployment and any structural normalization are later gates.
